agent: baseline agent without the ExecGraph skill (experiments/configs/base, hash 958ba110baa2), budget 8 min / 28 calls
tasks: the 41-task repo-proportional dev subset used for every earlier dev run (dev_eval N_TASKS=40)

arms.rwg: issue + top-5 functions from rwg_ppr at level R (deployable: no gold tests), parameters frozen from the E1 tune split
arms.goldfile: issue + the non-test files the gold patch edits (oracle localisation upper bound)

metric: resolved per task (scorer-like verification); paired comparison per model, exact McNemar test on discordant tasks, and the difference with a paired bootstrap CI

hypotheses.H7: goldfile - none is smaller for E4B than for 31B (localisation is less of the bottleneck for the small model)

secondary: whether the agent edits a gold file
notes: temperature 0.2 sampling: run-to-run noise on 41 tasks was +/-1-2 tasks for E4B; results within that are reported as null.
